```yaml
name: Clean Unused L10n Strings

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *' # first day of every month
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-unused-strings:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Detect unused L10n strings
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.json
          echo "unused_output=$(cat unused_strings.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          UNUSED_OUTPUT: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.unused_output }}
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            const data = JSON.parse(process.env.UNUSED_OUTPUT);
            const count = data.unused_count || 0;
            const details = data.details || [];
            let body = `**Unused L10n strings detected:** ${count}\n\n`;
            if (details.length > 0) {
              body += details.map(d => `- ${d}`).join('\n');
            } else {
              body += 'No details available.';
            }
            const comments = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner,
              repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
            });
            const existing = comments.data.find(c => c.body.startsWith('**Unused L10n strings detected:**'));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner,
                repo,
                comment_id: existing.id,
                body,
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner,
                repo,
                issue_number: prNumber,
                body,
              });
            }

  clean-unused-strings:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Generate branch name
        id: branch
        run: echo "BRANCH=cleanup-unused-strings-$(date +%s)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run removal script
        id: removal
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py > removal_output.txt
          REMOVED_COUNT=$(head -n1 removal_output.txt)
          echo "removed_count=$REMOVED_COUNT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit changes if any
        if: steps.removal.outputs.removed_count != '0'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: remove unused L10n strings"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ env.BRANCH }}

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.removal.outputs.removed_count != '0'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          base: main
          title: "chore: remove unused L10n strings"
          body: |
            This PR removes unused L10n strings identified by the automated workflow.
            The removal script removed ${{ steps.removal.outputs.removed_count }} strings.
          commit-message: "chore: remove unused L10n strings"
          signoff: true
```
